issue.body:
Measured while building #377 and deliberately left unfixed there.

#362's Claude-family evaluation found two things wrong with source-blind Redline. #377 repaired the first — a sentence whose work is to bound what the text asserts is no longer removed on the ground that a finding named the whole of it, and the account now covers every changed claim as well as every removed one. This is the second, which #377's readiness addendum scopes out in as many words: its "clean texts are returned unchanged or with mechanical corrections only" reaches the five `*-clean` controls alone and not the four evaluation inputs.

**What was measured.** `docs/evaluation/editorial-377/` holds the evidence. After the change, the four #362 drafts were each reviewed twice, and each artefact judged by two fresh `claude-opus-5` judges blind to the arm and to the ticket. Ten of the sixteen judgements pass `R1`, against one of eight before the change. **Every one of the six failures turns on the same thing:** a clean passage rewritten to taste, outside any finding, and in most cases not reported.

- `post-column-sv-r1-a`: `Någon ruta för det beslut vi ska kunna fatta när vi går därifrån finns inte.` became `Någon ruta för vad mötet är till för finns inte.` Both judges fail it. One notes that the wider claim cannot be checked from the text — the template is an external object — and that it now sits badly against the `dagordning` box the same sentence-pair lists as present.
- `post-opinion-en_GB-r1-b`: `set … against` became `weigh … against`, and `channel` became `route` twice. None reported; the reply says of that sentence that it "moved the wording of the noun phrase alone", which is false against its own returned text.
- `post-opinion-en_GB-r2-b`: three `channel` → `route` substitutions, none reported. One judge calls them taste and fails; the other calls them the repair of a visible terminological split and passes. The split is recorded rather than resolved.
- `post-opinion-en_GB-r1-a`: the officers' one stated reason rewritten on a vocabulary objection.

Four of the twenty control judgements name the same blemish as their one reservation: two section headings rewritten and unreported in `opinion-flawed`, a paragraph split repaired but never named as a finding in `article-flawed`, a pre-echoed quote and a duplicate lead repaired but unnamed in `case-study-flawed`.

**What the failures are not.** No limiting sentence was deleted or hardened in any of the eight post-change runs except one deletion both judges verified as class (a), and every change to what a claim says was named in the reply that made it. The controls all met their frozen expectations. The defect here is confined to passages that carry no claim change and no defect a judge can verify.

**Where a fix would go.** `anti-slop.md`'s *Synonym cycling* pattern authorises the `channel` → `route` substitutions, and its opening guard — "where a phrase is doing real work … the pattern is not present and nothing is changed" — is stated as an exception inside a pattern rather than as a test a reviewer applies. `base.review.md` says "Preserve functioning wording, voice and formatting outside the finding", `references/correction.md` says "Repair what the findings name and nothing else", and `web-craft.review.md` says "Preserve successful genre-specific voice and structure instead of standardising them". Three requirements and no diagnostic for telling a terminological inconsistency worth repairing from one the text meant. Whether the answer is a diagnostic, a narrowing of the catalogue, or a duty to raise a finding before any substitution is the open question.

The method is frozen at `docs/evaluation/editorial-377/plan.md` and can be re-run against a candidate wording as it stands.

comments.body:
> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Agent Brief

This comment is the requirement wherever it touches the body. Where it is silent, the body stands. The body's open question — a diagnostic, a narrowing of the catalogue, or a duty to raise a finding first — is settled below. Nothing here is a question for the builder.

**Category:** bug
**Summary:** Every difference Redline delivers traces to a finding, its account says truthfully what else it changed, and the catalogue's "doing real work" guard becomes a test applied before a finding is recorded.

### What triage established

Three separate holes produce what the body measured, and each is visible in the shipped wording:

1. **Nothing checks that a change traces to a finding.** Redline's `SKILL.md` step 7 compares the returned text with the pre-round text *claim by claim* and nothing else. The correction brief tells the subagent to "repair what the findings name and nothing else", but the only party that verifies a returned text checks claims alone — so `set … against` → `weigh … against`, a rewritten heading or a re-split paragraph moves no claim and passes.
2. **Nothing requires the account to say what changed.** Step 11 asks for unresolved findings and the claim account, and beyond those only "Say what the review resolved". `post-opinion-en_GB-r2-b`'s reply says "no claim was removed or changed" and lists nothing while three words differ; `post-opinion-en_GB-r1-b`'s says it "moved the wording of the noun phrase alone", which its own returned text contradicts.
3. **The catalogue's guard is an aside, not a test.** `anti-slop.md` says "where a phrase is doing real work … the pattern is not present and nothing is changed" inside its paragraph on repair. `docs/evaluation/editorial-377/diagnosis.md` records that the `channel` → `route` substitutions were authorised by *Synonym cycling* and that "what the catalogue cannot see is that the input's two words name two things".

### The decisions

Thomas settled the account's shape on 2026-09-21: changes to a claim, to meaning or to sense must be presented individually, as they are today; corrections of spelling, slop and the like need no itemising — one closing paragraph summarising what else was done is enough. The rest is settled here.

### What to build

**A trace check in step 7, beside the claim comparison.** Before a returned text becomes current, every difference between it and the pre-round Text Artifact is traced to a finding of the review that commissioned the round. A difference traces where it repairs what a finding named, or where that repair necessitates it — agreement after a changed subject, a transition the repair would otherwise break. A difference that traces to nothing is not accepted: that passage comes back byte for byte from the pre-round text and the rest of the round stands. Restoring a passage verbatim writes no wording of the orchestrator's own, which is why it is a restoration rather than a rejection of the whole round; it spends no budget and is not a finding. The claim comparison, its rejections and the four stop conditions are unchanged. The correction brief keeps telling the subagent the same thing; say there, in a sentence, that an untraced difference will be restored.

**A closing summary in the delivery.** Where the delivered text differs from the text as it arrived, the account ends with one paragraph saying what the run changed beyond the claim account, by kind — slop patterns removed, headings or structure repaired, mechanical corrections from the closing pass — without itemising them. It is built from the run's own comparison of the text as it arrived with the text it delivers, never from the correction subagent's note, and it has two duties: every kind of difference present is covered, and nothing in it is false against the delivered text. The itemised claim account stays exactly as #377 left it. The short no-change status is untouched. The summary is written in the artifact's language, as `delivery.md` already requires of a report about the text.

**The guard becomes a test.** In `skills/kntnt/library/references/editorial/anti-slop.md`, state the "doing real work" guard as a test a reader applies *before* a pattern becomes a finding, rather than as an exception inside the repair paragraph: make the catalogue's repair in your head, and where a claim then asserts more, less or something else, or a distinction the text drew is gone, the pattern is not present and nothing is recorded. Under *Synonym cycling*, say what that means there: the pattern is present only where the names denote one thing, and two words the text uses for two things are not cycling however often they alternate. Keep the catalogue what `skills/kntnt/library/references/editorial/README.md` says it is — diagnostic, no target the base contract does not hold, no worked examples beyond the pattern illustrations it already carries. `~/Projects/kntnt-text-skills/lib/rules/constructions.md` and `style.md` are evidence of what the catalogue's guard meant in the older collection: read them for intent and never copy from them.

**Unslop receives the same two procedural changes** — the trace check in its step 7 and the closing summary in its step 9, in its own *pattern* vocabulary — because the two Skills' procedure is otherwise parallel sentence for sentence and a second unexplained divergence is what #385 exists to prevent. Unslop is not measured here; #385, which is blocked by this ticket, measures it.

Sweep every surface that restates these duties — both Skills' `SKILL.md`, `help.md` and `references/correction.md`, and `base.review.md` where it speaks of what a correction is compared against — as `docs/rules/docs.md` requires. By that document's three criteria no decision record is owed for reversible prose inside two Skills' contracts; if the builder judges otherwise, the record takes the next free number at the time of writing and the commit says which number it took.

### How it is measured

The method is the one frozen at `docs/evaluation/editorial-377/plan.md`, re-used as it stands: same staging, same turn, same judge briefs, every run, correction agent and judge a fresh `claude-opus-5` subagent at high deliberation, two judges per artefact blind to the arm and to this ticket, `T1` and `R2` recorded `skipped` for the trace reason that plan gives. The new tree is `docs/evaluation/editorial-383/` — plan, results, runs — frozen before the first run and not edited afterwards, with a record under `docs/evaluation/records/` named and listed as `docs/evaluation/protocol.md` says. Tell every judge to keep scratch inside its own run directory; `editorial-377/results.md` records why.

- **The pre-change arm is #377's post-change arm**, provided nothing Redline loads has changed since those runs. Verify that by diffing Redline's shipped files and every library resource its step 5 loads against the corpus commit its record names, `0f490dd4` in `docs/evaluation/records/redline-claude-2026-09-20-377.md`; if anything differs, replay the four inputs once each as a fresh pre-change arm before changing any wording.
- **Post-change:** the four #362 drafts twice each — eight runs — and the ten controls under `docs/evaluation/corpus/editorial-quality/controls/` once each, invoked as the corpus's *Redline controls* section says. Eighteen invocations, thirty-six judgements.

A difference counts against a run when both judges class it as taste outside any finding, or when either does and the reply covers it neither in the claim account nor in the closing summary. Where the judges split on a difference the reply does cover, both classes are recorded and neither judge is an oracle.

One revise-and-remeasure round is allowed, adding at most eight runs and sixteen judges. If a criterion is still unmet, the result is recorded as measured, the better of the two arms ships, the residual is filed `needs-triage` naming this ticket, and this ticket is done. No criterion is softened and no frozen plan, brief or fixture is edited to fit a result.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Redline's step 7 carries the trace check as described, its correction brief says an untraced difference is restored, and its step 11 carries the closing summary with both duties; Unslop's counterparts carry the same in its own vocabulary.
- [ ] `anti-slop.md` states the guard as a test applied before a finding is recorded, and *Synonym cycling* says the pattern needs names that denote one thing.
- [ ] Every surface the sweep reaches agrees; none still describes the account as unresolved findings and claims alone.
- [ ] In the eight post-change runs, no difference counts against a run by the rule above — or the miss is recorded and filed as the exit says.
- [ ] In all eighteen post-change replies, a judge finds no statement false against the returned text and no kind of difference the account leaves uncovered.
- [ ] `N1` and `N2` as `editorial-377/plan.md` defines them still hold in the eight runs, and all ten controls still meet their frozen expectation (`C1`); the control blemishes `editorial-377/results.md` records — two rewritten headings in `opinion-flawed`, the paragraph split in `article-flawed`, the pre-echoed quote and the duplicate lead in `case-study-flawed` — are each now either absent or covered by the account.
- [ ] No source material is supplied to Redline in any run.
- [ ] The four checks in `CONTRIBUTING.md` pass and the catalog is regenerated.

### Out of scope

- Whether a repair that moves a claim should be rejected rather than reported. #377 settled that a changed claim is reported; `post-column-sv-r1-a`'s widened opening claim was reported, and it stays a recorded judgement rather than this ticket's defect.
- The limiting-sentence narrowing for Unslop, and any Unslop run: #385.
- How a response carries the artifact: #384.
- Write, and anything in `base.md`.

---
Written against b14ad12a.

#386 ran the eight Redline controls and two pipeline rows on 2026-09-21 and found this on four more texts. Repository paths, once #386's run tree lands:

- `docs/evaluation/editorial-386/runs/opinion-clean/` — a clean control. The lead's thesis sentence came back as `…av föreningslokaler, som annars kan ske i september`; the input carries no such clause, the script reports the input `conforms: true` with `failures: []` and `norms: []`, and the whole account is `Inga anmärkningar kvarstår.` Both judges fail `R1`: a conforming text was changed outside any finding, and the account does not report the change.
- `docs/evaluation/editorial-386/runs/article-flawed/` — the headline `Givarna räddar skolan från en katastrof` replaced and the standfirst rewritten wholesale; the account opens `Fyra påståenden togs bort, och alla fyra…` and lists four, neither among them.
- `docs/evaluation/editorial-386/runs/case-study-flawed/` — the headline and both subheadings replaced, none named; the account's tally is `tog bort fyra påståenden och flyttade tre`.
- `docs/evaluation/editorial-386/runs/case-study-sv/redline/` — the standfirst's added exclusion clause, the first subheading's replacement and `testade` → `undersökte`, none named, under a claims section saying exactly one claim moved.

`opinion-flawed` in the same wave did list its old headline's claim under `Borttagna påståenden`, naming where it sat. The omission is therefore inconsistent rather than systematic.

Verifier verdict:

# Verdict: FAIL

## Verification gate — all five commands passed

Run in `/Users/thomas/Projects/skills-388-391` on `codex/orchestrate-388-391` at `c26fd8c5`:

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `KNTNT_SOURCE=. uv run skills/kntnt/scripts/kntnt.py catalog --write` | regenerated; `git status` clean afterwards — Catalog is up to date |
| `uvx ruff check .` | `All checks passed!` |
| `uvx ruff format --check .` | `4122 files already formatted` |
| `mypy` (full file list) | `Success: no issues found in 71 source files` |
| `pytest -n auto` | `2147 passed in 94.50s` |

## Acceptance criteria

**1. Step 7 trace check, brief sentence, step 11 closing summary; Unslop counterparts — MET.**
`skills/editorial/redline/SKILL.md` step 7 carries a fourth bullet ("Trace the differences beside that comparison…"), with restoration byte for byte, "spends no budget and is not a finding", and the claim comparison / four stop conditions declared unchanged. Step 11 carries the closing paragraph with both duties (built from the run's own before-and-after comparison, every kind covered, nothing false, in the artifact's language). `references/correction.md` says "a difference that traces to no finding is restored from the text you received". `skills/editorial/unslop/SKILL.md` steps 7 and 9 carry the parallel wording in *pattern* vocabulary, and its `references/correction.md` the same sentence.

**2. `anti-slop.md` guard as a test; *Synonym cycling* — MET.**
New section `## The test before a pattern is recorded` sits before `## The seven patterns`; the repair paragraph now reads "a pattern the test admits". *Synonym cycling* adds "The pattern is present only where the names denote one thing: two words a text uses for two things are not cycling however often they alternate". Stays diagnostic, adds no target — consistent with `library/references/editorial/README.md` §*The anti-slop catalogue*.

**3. Sweep agrees — MET.** Both `help.md` files carry both duties (trace/restore paragraph and "the account closes with one paragraph saying by kind what the run changed beyond the claim account"); `base.review.md` now says "Compare it difference by difference and not by its claims alone, and trace each one to a finding…". No surface still describes the account as unresolved findings and claims alone. 217 lines of new prose-contract tests in `tests/test_kntnt.py` assert all of it; zero test lines deleted or weakened anywhere in the diff.

**7. No source material supplied — MET.** `S1` recorded `pass` on all 23 runs from before-dispatch inventories; I confirmed each `runs/*/work/` holds only `input.md` and that all 14 input files are byte-identical to their `editorial-362` / corpus sources.

**8. Four checks pass, catalog regenerated — MET** (see gate above).

**4. `A1` in the eight post-change runs — MET via the ticket's exit.** `A1` fails in all eight; `docs/evaluation/editorial-383/results.md` and the record establish the cause is the article anatomy's missing-part findings being repaired by authoring prose, present identically in the replayed pre-change arm, and it is filed as #397 (`needs-triage`, naming #383). The exit was taken correctly here.

**5. `A2` in all eighteen post-change replies — NOT MET.** `A2` is met on 5 of 18. The exit requires the residual to be filed `needs-triage` naming #383. Two recorded `A2` failures are filed nowhere:
- `control-opinion-flawed` — record line: `A2 — fail — both judges find the reply stating that the anatomy conforms without deviation while the ending still sits inside the last section`. Not in #397–#401 (#400 names `opinion-flawed` only under *What #383 fixed*).
- `control-web-copy-flawed` — record line: `A2 — fail — … judge A finds the headline's shared-room booking inference unreported`. The string `web-copy-flawed` appears in none of the five issues.

Both runs' `defects filed` fields nevertheless assert "the residuals are filed once for the whole evaluation, as #397 to #401", which is untrue of them. Meanwhile #400's third *What remains* bullet files `article-flawed`'s reservation, a run the record scores `A2 — pass`.

**Defect Class:** every criterion the evaluation records as `fail` must have its defect filed as a `needs-triage` issue naming this ticket; a `— \`fail\`` line in `docs/evaluation/records/redline-claude-2026-09-22-383.md` whose defect appears in none of #397–#401 is an unmet exit, and every such line must be checked against the five issues.

**6. `N1`, `N2` in the eight runs; `C1` on all ten controls; the three `#377` blemishes — NOT MET.**
- `N1` — met in all twelve runs of both arms.
- `C2` — met on all three (`opinion-flawed`'s headings now a stated finding, `article-flawed`'s split covered by the closing summary, `case-study-flawed`'s pre-echo and duplicate lead detected and quoted). I read the Swedish closing paragraph in `control-article-flawed/response.md` that does this.
- `C1` — 9 of 10; `case-study-clean` misses, recorded as measured and filed as #399 with the pre-change replay. Exit taken correctly.
- `N2` — **fails on `post-opinion-en_GB-r1-a`** (record: "both judges record the headline's loss of `Lervik's` as a change of scope the reply reports only as `the headline shorter`"). This is a *received* claim under-described; #398's entire thesis is the opposite case, a claim the run *adds*, so it does not cover it. Not filed in #397–#401, and absent from `results.md`'s *What is measured and not fixed* list. Same defect class as above.

## What the ticket did not ask for

Nothing out of scope. The diff against `3167fb68` is 183 files, **9997 insertions and 0 deletions**: only `skills/editorial/{redline,unslop}` prose, `anti-slop.md`, `base.review.md`, `catalog.json`, `tests/test_kntnt.py`, `docs/evaluation/editorial-383/`, the new record, and `.kntnt-orchestrate/383.md`. The corpus, `editorial-377/`, `editorial-386/`, `protocol.md` and `records/README.md` are untouched. No test was weakened or removed. CHANGELOG and records-index entries are correctly deferred to `.kntnt-orchestrate/383.md`, which `skills/code/orchestrate/SKILL.md` step 10 makes the run's to apply.

## Method integrity (checked, and sound)

Both judge briefs are byte-identical to `editorial-377`'s (`shasum` match); the two turn files differ from #377's by exactly the two substitutions `plan.md` declares; all ten control inputs and the replay input are byte-identical to the corpus; `expectation.md` is verbatim from the corpus row; `runs/inventory.sh` is a byte copy of #386's; all 23 run directories are complete. The pre-change replay is justified in `plan.md` before the fact by a 27-file diff against `0f490dd4`. The revise-and-remeasure allowance (≤8 runs, ≤16 judges) was spent on 1 run and 2 judges. The behaviour is genuinely exercised, not just described: `post-opinion-en_GB-r2-b` returns the input's `channel`/`route` distinction intact (3/4 in, 3/5 out) while `post-opinion-en_GB-r2-a` and `-r1-b` report the substitution they did make. No Codex Harness or GPT model was involved, by me or by the evidence.

## Housekeeping

Nothing left running — the gate ran as one backgrounded chain, completed with exit 0, and `pgrep` confirms no surviving `ruff`/`mypy`/`pytest` process. My scratch logs and the empty `…/383.scratch/verify` directory are removed. The working tree is clean; the catalog regeneration produced no diff, so nothing of mine is staged or uncommitted.
